user.title: E-REDES Account
user.description:
Enter your E-REDES Balcao Digital session cookie and CPE code.

To get your session cookie:
1. Log into balcaodigital.e-redes.pt
2. Open browser dev tools (F12)
3. Go to Network tab, select any request
4. Copy the full 'Cookie' header value

data_description.session_cookie: The full Cookie header from your browser (includes PHPSESSID, aat, SimpleSAML)
data_description.cpe: Your electricity meter CPE code (e.g., PT0002000012345678XX)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with E-REDES
reauth_confirm.description:
Your E-REDES session has expired. Please enter a new session cookie for CPE {cpe}.

To get your session cookie:
1. Log into balcaodigital.e-redes.pt
2. Open browser dev tools (F12)
3. Go to Network tab, select any request
4. Copy the full 'Cookie' header value
